key_insight: Eigenius preserves distinct proof derivations computationally while expressing proof irrelevance propositionally, enabling scientific knowledge stores to track evidence and retract dependent claims.
engineering_relevance: The framework could support auditable scientific databases that connect external verification, typed knowledge graphs, and provenance-aware dependency tracking.
method: Define a dependent type kernel with intensional equality and coercion-free subsumption.
Organize external verifiers through an institutional hierarchy with explicit axiom policies.
Combine justification logic, provenance semirings, and record types to represent scientific evidence.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistency, subject reduction, typing soundness and completeness, and Lean 4 mechanization with zero sorry axioms, but no empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: Practical scalability and end-to-end counterfactual retraction on real scientific datasets remain unestablished by the abstract.
paper_title: Typed Knowledge over Constructive Institutions: A Proof-Relevant Type Theory for Verified Science
